text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The clinical presentation of an 8-month-old with abdominal distension, localized left lower quadrant tenderness on palpation, feeding difficulties, and lack of bowel movements is highly suggestive of intussusception. The absence of a sausage-shaped mass on palpation does not rule out the condition, as it may be intermittent or obscured by pain. Immediate surgical consultation is required for potential reduction or resection.
